sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 3x to 6x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes action speed buffs and Cost recovery speed buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Removes frenzy.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Dawn for 90 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000

[Friends Forever] Filo & Melty or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
